alex: Quick PSA — final check for the release in ~3h. If you have a changeset that should go into v0.12.0, please add a one-liner to CHANGELOG and include the PR number. Keep entries short (<80 chars). Changelog lint will run on merge. Example:
```
- add(runtime): make batching TTL configurable (#1234)
```
alex: Also tag the component (runtime/console/optimize) in the one-liner. Cutoff in ~180 minutes — after that we only accept emergency backports. :clock3:
release-bot: CUTOVER REMINDER: changelog cutoff scheduled in 3 hours for v0.12.0. Please ensure entries are pushed and PRs are targeting release/v0.12.
meera: quick q — for the small behavior tweak I just merged, should we bump minor or patch? doesn't change APIs, just fixes ordering.
alex: patch if it's strictly a bugfix or correctness change. Minor if it's a new opt-in capability or public behavior change. From your description, patch sounds right.
tanner: small logistics q — for backports, we still use branch `release/v0.12` right? i'm about to open a cherry-pick PR.
alex: yep, target `release/v0.12` for backports. if you need a hand with the cherry-pick commit message ping me and i'll approve.
jamie: added one-liner to CHANGELOG in PR #2118: `- fix: prevent double-counting in prefix cache (#2118)` :thumbsup:
lisa: can someone sanity-check the formatting of my proposed entry? Proposed: 
```
- fix(runtime): avoid double-counting tokens for cached prefixes (#2118)
```
alex: looks good. we prefer the component in parentheses after the type, so `fix(runtime):` is perfect. tiny nit — no trailing period and use present tense (you've got that).
meera: i'll run the changelog-lint locally and push any formatting fixes if needed.
release-bot: changelog-lint job queued for PR #2118 — status: queued.
jamie: changelog-lint passed on CI for #2118, merging in 5. :white_check_mark: :rocket:
alex: awesome, thanks all. Reminder: after cutoff only critical fixes go to `release/candidates`. If anyone wants to coordinate a hotfix, DM me so we can triage.
_meta: This thread is a short release coordination exchange: cutoff nudge, example snippets, branch targets, lint/CI references. Messages are intentionally concise and in Slack style.
